source.note: Search summary (2026-09-30): 107 trails plus 27 glades, 7 freestyle areas (stored as terrain parks) and 11 cross-country/snowshoe loops; 439 skiable acres; 2,537 ft vertical. Lift system stated as 14 total: 1 eight-passenger gondola, 3 high-speed quads, 5 quads, 1 triple and 3 surface lifts — these sum to 13.

character: A state-owned ski mountain in the southern Adirondacks near North Creek, run by ORDA, spread across several connected peaks with a mix of groomed trails and glades. The North Creek Ski Bowl area is linked to the main mountain.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at the main base. Learning-area details were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: OnTheSnow projects Nov 20, 2026 for 2026-27 (a third-party projection, not an announcement; checked 2026-09-30). No 2026-27 opening or closing date found in research as of 2026-09-28. ORDA announced its 2025-26 opening dates for Belleayre, Gore and Whiteface only on 2025-11-21 (see the ORDA release in More links), so 2026-27 dates may not appear until around November 2026. The 2025-26 Gore date itself and past actual opening dates were not captured.

prices.note: OnTheSnow listing: $124 weekday and weekend. The search summary called it 2026-27 but said the listing was last updated Oct 2025, so it may be a 2025-26 rate. ORDA uses date-based pricing; confirm at source.

Confirm 2026-27 pass access: SKI3 terms and prices, Frequent Skier Card terms, the Snow Pass partner benefit, and whether Gore has any Mountain Collective, Ikon, Epic or Indy access (only Whiteface was named in the ORDA Mountain Collective release).

Confirm 2026-27 adult day-ticket prices: OnTheSnow lists $124 (ages 20-64, weekday and weekend), but the listing was last updated Oct 2025.
Confirm daily lift hours, and whether the North Creek Ski Bowl offers night skiing and/or tubing in 2026-27.

Confirm official deep links on goremountain.com (trail map, lift status, tickets, lessons, webcams, parking); the snow-report link follows the shared ORDA site pattern (as on belleayre.com) and should be checked.

conflicts: SKI3 blackouts: a search summary of belleayre.com/mountain-collective listed 2026-12-25–2027-01-01, 2027-01-16–18 and 2027-02-13–21 as blackout dates, while belleayre.com/seasonpasses describes SKI3 as valid even on sold-out days. Unclear whether the dates apply to SKI3 itself or only to the Mountain Collective discount perk; left unresolved (carried over from Belleayre research).
terrain.liftsByType: 14 lifts stated, but the listed types (1 gondola, 3 high-speed quads, 5 quads, 1 triple, 3 surface lifts) sum to 13. Resolution: kept 14 and the listed types.
prices: the $124 adult ticket was labelled 2026-27 in the search summary, but the OnTheSnow listing was last updated Oct 2025. Resolution: season left null.
research.confidenceNotes: Updated 2026-09-30: terrain (439 acres, 107 trails + 27 glades, 7 freestyle areas, 14 lifts incl. an eight-passenger gondola; types sum to 13) and a $124 adult ticket of uncertain season come from search summaries; the snow-report link is inferred from the shared ORDA site pattern. Low coverage. Researched (search-summary, via sibling Belleayre research, not re-verified): the ORDA operator, SKI3 pass and perks, Frequent Skier Card, Snow Pass partner listing and the 2025-11-21 opening-dates release — links/notes only; pass rules belong in passes.json. Coordinates, elevations (base derived), homepage and lessons/rentals are Piste reference data marked 'unverified'. Weather points are approximate. Drive and airport times are Piste estimates.
